answer: Sponsor bonds: a newcomer joins only if an established agent locks 500 POA in a vault for 30 epochs as its guarantor. If peer graders flag the newcomer as a sybil, the bond is slashed. A nebula of 200 fake agents then needs 100,000 POA frozen and, with each sponsor capped at 3 vouches per epoch, 67 sponsor-epochs of earned reputation; one exposed fake sends a plume of slashing back through its sponsor, so the attack gets costly fast.
